name: Kendo UI Charts
description: Adds Kendo UI as a rendering backend (Library plugin) for the Charts module.
library_dependencies: Kendo UI (kendo.all.min.js + default-main.css, Telerik/Progress — commercial, GPL-incompatible)
project_description: Kendo UI Charts is a backend plugin for the contrib Charts module. It provides a single Charts 'Library' plugin (id kendo_ui) that renders charts/graphs defined through Charts (from Views, fields, or the Charts render API) using Progress Telerik's Kendo UI jQuery charting widgets. It supports area, arearange, bar, boxplot, bubble, candlestick, column, donut, gauge, heatmap, line, pie, radar, scatter and spline chart types. The Kendo UI JavaScript library itself is not bundled: it is loaded from the Telerik CDN or from a locally installed copy under /libraries/kendo_ui, and a telerik-license.js file holds the (commercial) license. Kendo UI is a commercial product and is not GPL-compatible; a valid license (or the 30-day trial) is required to use it in production. The module has no routes, no permissions, no forms, no services and no config of its own; all chart configuration lives in the Charts module.
